# LaTeX Formatting Cheat Sheet

Cairn provides typography-grade KaTeX formula rendering with live preview editing and autocomplete.

## Matrix Formulations

$$
A = \begin{pmatrix}
a_{11} & a_{12} & \dots & a_{1n} \\
a_{21} & a_{22} & \dots & a_{2n} \\
\vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\
a_{m1} & a_{m2} & \dots & a_{mn}
\end{pmatrix}
$$

## Quantum Formulations

Density operator representing `QUANTUM-ENTANGLEMENT` in a mixed state:

$$
\rho = \sum_i p_i |\psi_i\rangle \langle\psi_i|
$$

The von Neumann entropy of state $\rho$ is:

$$
S(\rho) = -\text{Tr}(\rho \ln \rho)
$$

## Calculus and Integration

$$
\int_{-\infty}^\infty e^{-x^2} dx = \sqrt{\pi}
$$
